subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the linked PR’s fenced session-runtime retirement and harness-reset path after bounded reply-session conflict retries are exhausted?
rationale: Current main improves transient conflicts with bounded retries, but deciding whether a persistent conflict may interrupt competing work and reset shared harness state is a lifecycle-policy choice.

options.title: Adopt fenced recovery
options.body: Rebase and land the linked PR after exact-head review, accepting one bounded admission drain and runtime/harness reset only after revalidation.

options.title: Keep retry-only behavior
options.body: Retain the current bounded retry path and require a fresh current-main reproduction that proves persistent conflicts still warrant disruptive lifecycle recovery.

recommendation.title: Adopt fenced recovery
recommendation.body: Rebase and land the linked PR after exact-head review, accepting one bounded admission drain and runtime/harness reset only after revalidation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior session continuity and topic-transcript work is closest to the policy boundary in question.
